column1: # What Felix asks reality about veldra.
# Felix may declare which question to ask. Felix may never author the answer.
# Each row names a predicate and the command that enumerates its members; the
# members come back from the command, and nothing in the engine can add one.
# predicate
# A row with no witness can never report `empty` and always blocks as
# `unknown`. Each witness here asks a different question from its probe: the
# filesystem against cargo's resolution, git's index against the disk.
# `workspace_member` and `http_service` are asked of cargo rather than of the
# manifests, and the difference is the point. Measured 2026-09-03: cargo
# reports axum in SEVEN of sixteen members, and the root manifest names it in
# none of them — workspace inheritance means a member's real dependency set is
# not written in any single file a grep can read. A scan that reads manifests
# finds zero HTTP services here and reports that as clean, which is within one
# step of what this project's own superscan did when its D5 check ended with
# `exit 0` and printed "All gates passed" while naming four unlimited services.
workspace_member
column4: cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1 --offline | python3 -c "import json,sys;[print(p['name']) for p in json.load(sys.stdin)['packages']]"
